verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for an email marketing SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes an in-product AI assistant or agent that users can delegate tasks to. The closest item is automatic design generation in brand colours, which is an adjacent automation feature, not a task-delegation assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
